title: INMP441 microphone: I2S audio on ESP32

spans.text: INMP441 is a digital MEMS microphone that sends audio over I2S. It is not an analog-input sensor and suits audio processing and fast sampling.
ESP32: SCK/BCLK→GPIO26, WS/LRCL→GPIO25, SD/DOUT→GPIO32, VDD→3.3V, GND→GND. L/R selects the left or right mono slot.
A good fit is ESP32 with ESP-IDF 5.x: configure an I2S RX channel and read signed 24-bit samples from 32-bit slots. Arduino IDE is also possible, but its I2S API depends on core version.

spans.title: Important safety note
spans.text: INMP441 and ESP32 use 3.3 V logic. Verify power and clock pins; this is a configuration skeleton that must be completed for your ESP-IDF version.
